title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton: on fresh seed 4 vesicles form from noise and persist, but none carries the catalyst; K sits only on an open strip, and the K-free vesicles live on amphiphile shared through the bath (kb=0), so E is a population-level, largely constructed dependence
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_starve.py (feed off at t=300) unchanged on fresh seed 4 to t=600. From the noisy bath, worm-like micelles close into vesicles by t~200; at t=600 the fed run holds a double-walled vesicle and a single vesicle (u+1>0.6 areas 705 and 209 px) plus a micelle pair, total amphiphile settling at ~2060. Per-body catalyst content (bodies.txt) shows both vesicles carry essentially no K (sum K 0.1-0.3 against 160-460 on the K-carrying bodies), and labkit finds K membrane-like in 0/27 individuals (aggregate rim/core 0.46). The K lives on an open filament across the periodic corner, and the vesicles persist on amphiphile made there and shared through the bath: the code's extra bath-monomer decay kb is 0 in world.py, so leaked product is not penalised. Cutting the feed shrinks everything (total 2355 -> 323 by t=600; the vesicles break into micelle clusters, fed_vs_starved_seed4.png), as in the claim's fork, but the vesicles that respond are not the ones that metabolise.

observations.I: rerun/seed4/sheet.png t=237-600: two discrete vesicles of constant size (bodies.txt: 209 and 705 px at t=600)

seeds_run.result: S and I pass; no vesicle carries K (sum K <= 0.3 per vesicle), K not membrane-like in 0/27 individuals
starve fork at t=300: total amphiphile 2355 -> 323, vesicles break into micelle clusters; K-free vesicles shrink as much as K bodies

controls_run.E: starve/seed4 (world_starve.py, feed off at t=300) against rerun/seed4 (fed)

verdicts.limitation: B (a K layer on the bilayer) did not appear on seed 4: the catalyst sits on an open strip, not on any vesicle. E: amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays everywhere at kap, so dependence on the feed holds by construction, and with kb=0 the product is shared through the bath, so K-free vesicles persist as well as K-carrying ones; the metabolism is a property of the population and the medium, not of an individual. I ran one fresh seed and did not run the no-K or no-gate controls.
